description: Accepting generated code without reading or testing it, iterating by pasting errors back. Coined by Andrej Karpathy in February 2025 for throwaway projects.
Simon Willison's October 2025 name for experienced developers using agents while staying accountable for what they ship; superseded by "agentic engineering".
Building production software with agents you orchestrate and oversee, with tests, specs, review and measurement. Proposed by Karpathy in February 2026.
Plausible, low-quality generated content or code produced in volume and accepted without review.
The 2025 DORA report's framing: AI magnifies a team's existing strengths and dysfunctions rather than fixing them.
